newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU inflation slightly up at 2.4 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: EU inflation slightly up at 2.4 pct in October.

text.p: Inflation in the European Union rose slightly to 2.4 percent in October from the record low level of 2.3 percent seen in the previous two months, Eurostat, the EU's statistical office, said on Friday.
The inflation figures varied between member states, ranging from an annualised fall of 0.1 percent in Sweden to an inflation rate of 8.3 percent year-on-year in Greece.
"All southern member states were above the EU average," Eurostat said in a statement.
In October last year EU inflation stood at three percent.
